import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('.temp/TASK-261017-sxydvh/refresh-402fdbc9')
def clean(s):
 s=re.sub(r'-----BEGIN [^-]*PRIVATE KEY-----.*?-----END [^-]*PRIVATE KEY-----','<REDACTED_PRIVATE_KEY>',s,flags=re.S)
 s=re.sub(r'(?:ssh-ed25519|ssh-rsa) [A-Za-z0-9+/=]+(?: [^\n]*)?','<REDACTED_PUBLIC_KEY>',s)
 s=re.sub(r'https?://[^/\s@]+@',lambda m:m.group().split('://')[0]+'://<REDACTED_USERINFO>@',s)
 s=s.replace(str(Path.cwd()),'<WORKTREE>').replace(str(Path.home()),'<HOST_HOME>')
 s=re.sub(r'<HOST_HOME>/\s"]+','<HOST_HOME>',s)
 s=re.sub(r'/(?:private/)?var/folders/[^\s"]+','<TEMP_PATH>',s)
 s=re.sub(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', '<REDACTED_EMAIL>',s)
 return s
assert clean('<HOST_HOME> <TEMP_PATH> <REDACTED_EMAIL>')=='<HOST_HOME> <TEMP_PATH> <REDACTED_EMAIL>'
assert clean('https://<REDACTED_USERINFO>@host.example')=='https://<REDACTED_USERINFO>@host.example'
assert clean('fixture api.test x.test.evil.com exfiltrate.example.com')=='fixture api.test x.test.evil.com exfiltrate.example.com'
def walk(v):
 if isinstance(v,str):return clean(v)
 if isinstance(v,list):return[walk(x)for x in v]
 if isinstance(v,dict):return{k:walk(x)for k,x in v.items()}
 return v
def sanitize(p):
 lines=[]
 for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
  try:lines.append(json.dumps(walk(json.loads(line)),ensure_ascii=False))
  except ValueError:lines.append(clean(line))
 return '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
groups={g:[]for g in ('network','cli','install','godriver','envprofile','packages','validation')}
for p in sorted(b.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file()or p.suffix=='.pid' or p.name in ('local-full.jsonl',):continue
 if p.name.startswith(('audit-isolated','profile-vectors-isolated')):group='network'
 elif p.name.startswith(('curator-','trunk-extra-')):group='cli'
 elif p.name.startswith('install-'):group='install'
 elif p.name.startswith('godriver-'):group='godriver'
 elif p.name.startswith('envprofile-'):group='envprofile'
 elif p.name.startswith(('packages-','packages01-','crossconformance-')):group='packages'
 else:group='validation'
 payload=sanitize(p);raw=p.read_bytes()
 assert '<HOST_HOME> in payload and str(Path.home())not in payload,p
 groups[group].append({'name':str(p.relative_to(b)),'content':payload,'raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest(),'raw_lines':len(raw.splitlines()),'sanitized_lines':len(payload.splitlines())})
index=[]
for group,records in groups.items():
 dest=Path('/tmp')/('TASK-261017-sxydvh_refresh_'+group+'.jsonl')
 with dest.open('w')as f:
  f.write(json.dumps({'format':'sanitized-file-bundle-v1','group':group,'files':len(records),'candidate':'5ceef5a6656555f87460ec4c05875d18c6e0b5fb','redactions':'Host and temporary paths, email addresses, key material and URL userinfo; all events preserved.'})+'\n')
  for r in records:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
 index.append({'resource':dest.name,'files':len(records),'bytes':dest.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
# Independently read every emitted record back and require all Go events to survive.
event_count=0
for group in groups:
 p=Path('/tmp')/('TASK-261017-sxydvh_refresh_'+group+'.jsonl')
 records=[json.loads(l)for l in p.read_text().splitlines()][1:]
 for r in records:
  assert hashlib.sha256(r['content'].encode()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
  if r['name'].endswith('.log')and any(r['name'].startswith(v)for v in ('audit-isolated','profile-vectors-isolated','curator-','install-','godriver-','envprofile-','packages-','packages01-','crossconformance-','trunk-extra-')):
   for line in r['content'].splitlines():
    try:e=json.loads(line)
    except ValueError:continue
    if 'Action'in e:event_count+=1
summary=json.loads((b/'summary.json').read_text());assert event_count==summary['events'],(event_count,summary['events'])
p=Path('/tmp/TASK-261017-sxydvh_refresh_index.json');p.write_text(json.dumps({'bundles':index,'preserved_go_events':event_count,'redaction_controls':'paths/email/userinfo redacted; fixture hosts retained'},indent=2))
print(json.dumps({'bundles':index,'preserved_go_events':event_count}))
